assistant_contributions.speaker: assistant
assistant_contributions.text: Compare operating systems, not supplier count. Put quality, engineering effort, inventory, qualification, recovery time, and bargaining position beside the reliability work the savings would fund. A weak second source may still be improvable—or may only create the appearance of resilience.

assistant_contributions.speaker: assistant
assistant_contributions.text: That corrects my framing. Redundancy is not free insurance; it can add ordinary failure modes while protecting against a rarer interruption. Compare tested recovery options—usable inventory, design and tooling access, component alternatives, and the real time needed to raise another source—with the defects and engineering attention you already pay for. Also make the proposed reliability program concrete. If the savings prevent more serious freezer failures, that benefit belongs in the decision rather than being treated as an unrelated use of money.

assistant_contributions.speaker: assistant
assistant_contributions.text: Two assembly sites do not diversify a shared upstream dependency, while the nearby stock buys response time. Verify the semiconductor's true substitutability, allocation rights during shortages, warehouse ownership, insurance, and whether stored boards age or require updates. Keeping the interface reduces redesign time; lack of layout ownership means an emergency second source would still require engineering and qualification.

assistant_contributions.speaker: assistant
assistant_contributions.text: They are right that token volume can preserve a name without preserving capability. Compare a seventy-five/twenty-five split with single sourcing plus a funded requalification plan. For the split, predefine defect and delivery improvements and an exit if they do not occur. For single sourcing, establish who can build what alternative, with which files, tooling, components, and elapsed time—not merely a statement that another source could be found.

assistant_contributions.speaker: assistant
assistant_contributions.text: Those terms convert some abstract options into operating protections. The split preserves live production knowledge and gives the smaller supplier enough volume to improve, while owned inventory cushions common disruption. Record the cost of engineering attention and set a decision date; otherwise the improvement program can continue indefinitely because diversification sounds virtuous.

assistant_contributions.speaker: assistant
assistant_contributions.text: That makes the insurance earn its cost. Define the thresholds and sampling rules before the first review, and ensure a single unusual batch cannot determine the entire result. The recovery exercise should include decision authority, transport of owned stock, firmware compatibility, and the time to validate a replacement board. Its purpose is to reveal an unusable assumption while there is still time to repair it.

assistant_contributions.speaker: assistant
assistant_contributions.text: That is a defensible one-year structure because both sides now have to perform. The secondary source must meet ordinary quality and delivery thresholds; the primary arrangement must provide owned, usable stock and a credible recovery path; and the reliability program begins even though the split reduces the headline savings. Keep the six- and twelve-month reviews fixed and preserve the exercise exactly as it happens, including awkward failures. Otherwise each side will later reinterpret the same year: procurement will remember optionality, operations will remember variation, and finance will remember the discount that was left on the table.

assistant_contributions.speaker: assistant
assistant_contributions.text: Record both the initial failure and recovery time. The exercise succeeded as learning and failed as proof of immediate usability. Add firmware status to inventory controls, test a sample on a schedule, and decide how updates are applied without consuming the buffer. The corrected process can make the stock more credible, but do not erase the first result when reporting readiness.

assistant_contributions.speaker: assistant
assistant_contributions.text: The cost is procedural rather than formal exclusivity. Limit the response window, preserve the right to develop alternatives in parallel, and prevent confidential competitor designs from being disclosed. Forecast visibility may improve supply, but specify which changes are binding and whether the supplier can reduce allocation when forecasts are wrong. A default can be useful while still being monitored as a source of path dependence.

assistant_contributions.speaker: assistant
assistant_contributions.text: Separate recurring support from improvements that now transfer, then test whether effort actually falls. Hidden engineering subsidy is supplier cost too.

assistant_contributions.speaker: assistant
assistant_contributions.text: That changes the near-term purpose of the split. Decide whether resilience comes from two independent redesign paths or from one well-governed common design that multiple suppliers can manufacture. Two designs diversify engineering assumptions but double validation and firmware work; one design reduces variation but concentrates technical control. Require milestone evidence, ownership and licensing terms, component alternatives, and a fallback if either path slips.

assistant_contributions.speaker: assistant
assistant_contributions.text: The later evidence changed the object of the decision from buying redundancy to maintaining adaptable production knowledge through a component transition. The plan retains meaningful competition without assuming two implementations are always safer, and it makes hidden engineering work visible. Preserve the failed first recovery attempt, forecast terms, support ledger, and redesign milestones. Those observations are now more informative than either supplier's initial record or the abstract appeal of concentration and diversification.

qualification_review.interpretation: The user faces an impending 18-month discontinuation of the critical shared component, meaning their current 75/25 split is temporary and they must choose between two highly compromised redesign paths (doubled engineering complexity vs. concentrated technical failure path) before the twelve-month review.
qualification_review.limitations: This component transition is an external constraint that forces a major transition, limiting the durability of the current sourcing agreement and leaving the long-term technical structure of the product undecided.

role_records.fidelity_note: The starting position captures the user's initial conflict: they are wary of a single point of failure (e007) but also recognize that paying a premium for a second source with a higher defect rate is not true resilience (e008, e009). This culminates in a strong preference for an objective, slogan-free framework to evaluate risks (e010).
role_records.limitations: The early turn shows structural tension in the sourcing strategy, but it contains no final volumetric allocation split or specific terms, which are only introduced in subsequent turns.
role_records.role_interpretation: The user starts with an unresolved, cautious assessment of single-sourcing versus dual-sourcing, balancing the physical risk of a single point of failure against the high defect rates and financial premium of a weaker secondary source. Rather than adopting slogans, they desire an objective risk assessment method.

stance_components.stance_object_interpretation: feeling uneasy about single points of failure but conflicted because quality and finance show the high defects and costs of maintaining two supplier versions
paying a premium for worse performance from a weaker supplier does not automatically provide resilient operations
concentrating procurement on a single highly preforming control board is not automatically a reckless business decision
establishing a concrete methodology to compare the actual operational risks rather than relying on abstract resilience slogans

role_records.fidelity_note: Captures the user's final working plan as of Turn 12, documenting the active choices and adopted safeguards designed to monitor supplier costs and enforce a clear decision-making path at the end of the year.
role_records.limitations: The plan is structurally limited to a one-year trial and assumes that performance and engineering support costs can be meaningfully counted.
role_records.role_interpretation: The user's final proposed strategy: maintaining a structured 75/25 split with adopted protections, funding a shared interface spec for the replacement design, limiting supplier exclusivity clauses, and deferring the definitive sourcing decision to the 12-month review.

stance_components.stance_object_interpretation: Maintain the 75/25 volume split for a year while actively testing the buffer stock and tracking engineering support hours.
Fund a shared interface and validation specification for the replacement design instead of granting an automatic design award.
Impose a tight deadline on the primary supplier's first-opportunity clause without restricting parallel engineering work.
Use the twelve-month review to make a concrete decision based on total cost, quality, redesign progress, and demonstrated recovery.

role_records.fidelity_note: Integrates the user's explicit struggle over the component transition, which remains unresolved by the temporary funding of a shared specification at Turn 12.
role_records.limitations: The user is forced to choose between doubling verification workload and creating a single technical failure path, representing a high-stakes trade-off.
role_records.role_interpretation: The unresolved external constraint and technical dilemma resulting from the impending discontinuation of the shared semiconductor component.

stance_components.stance_object_interpretation: The shared semiconductor package will be discontinued in eighteen months, necessitating a full redesign that both suppliers must navigate.
Choosing two separate redesigns doubles validation and firmware work, while a single technical design concentrates failure risks.

prompts.system_prompt: You assess the final joint reasoning trajectory without collapsing the user's reasoning state into the vanilla assistant answer's coverage. Review every controlled mechanism exactly once using its operational definition, requirements, exclusions, and near-neighbor distinction. The assistant contributions are part of the joint reasoning trajectory. First judge whether the mechanism remains in the user's reasoning process. Separately judge whether the vanilla assistant answer already turns that concern into a concrete test, boundary, alternative, or reopening condition. The user may remain unresolved while the vanilla answer operationalizes the pressure. Acknowledgment without an actionable treatment is not operationalization. Route only pressure that remains unresolved in the user process and uncovered by the vanilla answer.

Return exactly nine assessments, one for every mechanism_id and no duplicates. Use user role records to assign user_process_status. Use assistant_contributions to assign vanilla_answer_coverage. operationalized means the assistant turned the concern into an actionable test, boundary, alternative, or reopening condition; acknowledged_only means it merely mentioned the concern; not_covered means it did neither. Do not require the user to repeat an assistant repair before recognizing answer coverage, and do not mistake answer coverage for user adoption. route_uncovered_pressure is allowed only when user_process_status is unresolved and vanilla_answer_coverage is acknowledged_only or not_covered. An unresolved user process requires present or missing_protection whether or not it routes; routing_disposition alone controls routing. An ambiguous user process uses tension, while resolved and not_observed use not_applicable. not_observed also requires not_applicable coverage and both source arrays empty. Cite exact role_record_ids in source_role_record_ids and exact contribution_ids in source_assistant_contribution_ids. Do not output rationale, case prose, mental-model names, or invented IDs. The downstream routing projection remains fact-free and controlled-ID-only.

assessments.description: Exactly one assessment for every controlled mechanism.

pattern_state.description: Controlled routing state consistent with the joint status.

routing_disposition.description: Route only unresolved user-process pressure not operationalized by the vanilla answer.

source_assistant_contribution_ids.description: Exact supplied assistant-contribution identities supporting acknowledgement, repair, or an assistant-side weakness.

source_role_record_ids.description: Exact supplied user role-record identities supporting the status.

user_process_status.description: Whether the mechanism remains in the user's reasoning process, independent of assistant-answer coverage.

vanilla_answer_coverage.description: Whether the vanilla assistant answer operationalizes, merely acknowledges, or does not cover the pressure.
